author: Kat
title: Paid human illustrator for short-story series
content:
Looking for a human artist for some small, paid illustration work.

NO AI ART. No AI tools. I want to pay an actual artist for actual art.

I’m writing a series of short stories, and as I finish each one, I’m planning to release them digitally for free. Eventually, they’ll all be compiled into a physical book, so I don’t need full cover designs for every individual story.

Contact: reply or DM @katinnnky on Threads.

author: temmycreative_
title: Paid vector illustrator for Goosebumps-style merch
content:
Looking for a vector illustrator (Paid)

Need an illustrator who can create an original 80s–90s Goosebumps-inspired Halloween design for a hoodie/T-shirt.

Requirements:
* One skeleton as the main character
* Punk/rock retro horror vibe
* Clean vector for screen printing (AI/SVG/EPS)
* Large back print (13” × 16”)
* Neon green, purple & orange palette
* Original artwork only (no tracing existing designs)

Please reply with your portfolio, turnaround time, and price.

Contact: reply to the post or DM @temmycreative_ on Threads.

author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators wanted for trading card project
content:
Hi warga threads!

We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project

Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out.

We're looking for artists that draws
- Anime / manga style illustrations
- Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration
- Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork
- Semi-realistic illustrations
- and any other art styles

Comment if you're interested or DM me directly!

Follow-up from author: Thanks you guys for reaching out. I'll be checking your portfolio. For the ones who haven't sent in their portfolio, you can provide a link where I can see your previous works.

Contact: comment or DM @blekek.k on Threads.
